description: Scaffold the inventory-app scenario using the standard Vrooli react-vite template (API + UI + CLI + service.json). Acceptance: scenario can be started via vrooli scenario start inventory-app, the UI loads, the CLI is callable, and the API exposes minimum GET /items (list) and POST /items (create) endpoints.
name: inventory-app-scenario-init
title: Initialize Inventory-App Scenario From React-Vite Template
